description: Read a power cable datasheet (an https link to a PDF or page, or pasted text) into constructions: each size's voltage, cores, conductor, layers with nominal and smallest thickness, screen, armour, diameters and standards, with page and row. An LLM (Claude) reads, deciding nothing; with standard set the rules check each row. Notes: thecablecode://guide/extract_datasheet. Price (USDC, x402): a paid call from the first document: $2.00 in USDC per document, no free allowance.

hint.description: A designation or size to look for, e.g. "3x95/25 12/20 kV": only matching rows are returned.

standard.description: Also check every row: "auto" (the standards each row claims, else IEC 60502 by voltage) or rule sets, comma separated.

text.description: Pasted datasheet, catalogue or tender text.

url.description: An https link to a PDF datasheet or a datasheet web page.

name: extract_datasheet
title: Read a cable datasheet into constructions
